release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.51 polishes the Profiles hierarchy and expands secure profile imports. The Profiles retailer rail now matches the readable Tasks sizing, with wider retailer rows and unclipped labels such as Pokémon Center. Ungrouped Profiles no longer remains stuck in the main stage after the user clicks a retailer, toggles Ungrouped off, or navigates away, while normal named profile groups remain selected on repeat clicks. Profiles can now store payment-card and billing fields plus retailer-specific secure extras through a dedicated encrypted local profile vault instead of placing sensitive values in ui-state.json. The vault uses AES-256-GCM and protects its random key with Windows DPAPI in production builds. Profile import no longer rejects payment fields, passwords, auth/session tokens, or unknown secret-like retailer fields; those values are routed into the encrypted vault while ordinary identity, shipping, tags, archive metadata, and group assignment remain in normal profile state. Dedicated Go and real Chromium regression coverage verifies encrypted-at-rest storage, no sensitive plaintext leakage into normal UI state, Tasks-sized rail geometry, unclipped retailer labels, corrected Ungrouped selection behavior, secure profile editing, secure imports, the full browser suite, and the 120-task soak.
